prompt: We have about 30 markdown files in docs/ and nobody knows which ones are tutorials vs reference vs guides. Classify them and show me where the gaps are.

assertions.text: Classifies documents using the two Diataxis axes (action/cognition, acquisition/application)
Produces a coverage matrix table (feature/component x quadrant)
Identifies specific gaps (missing tutorials, missing reference, etc.)
Uses Diataxis terminology correctly (quadrants, modes, tutorials vs how-to distinction)
